entry.title: How Can Artificial Intelligence Recognize Objects in Images and Videos?
entry.summary: A camera captures an image in milliseconds. Recognizing what is inside that image, however, is a much more interesting problem. When you upload a photograph to Google Lens or use your phone's camera to identify an object, the software is doing more than comparing colors or matching shapes. It uses models trained on visual data to recognize patterns that are associated with objects, people, places, and other things. This field is called computer vision. What makes it interesting is that a computer does not need a programmer to manually describe every possible object. A trained model can learn useful visual features from examples and apply them to images it has never seen before. So, how does that actually work? Every digital photograph is made up of pixels. entry.title: The Borrow Checker Gaps That Let Unsafe Code Compile
entry.summary: Two soundness bugs in Rust's borrow checker have been open since 2013 and 2014. They allow code that violates aliasing rules to compile without unsafe blocks. If you write libraries that expose safe APIs over unsafe internals, or if you rely on the borrow checker to enforce invariants in complex data structures, these holes can let undefined behavior slip into production. You'll learn: Which code patterns trigger the unsoundness How to audit your crate for the affected constructs Practical workarounds that keep your API safe today The first bug (issue #164250 tracks both) involves two-phase borrows and reborrowing through raw pointers. When you create a raw pointer from a mutable reference, then reborrow that pointer as a shared reference, the borrow checker can lose track of the original …

entry.title: DDL and DML in SQL: Understanding the Two Essential Parts of Database Management
entry.summary: When working with databases, writing SQL queries is only part of the job. You also need to understand how databases are structured and how the information inside them is managed. This is where two important SQL concepts come in: Data Definition Language (DDL) and Data Manipulation Language (DML). Although both are used when working with databases, they serve different purposes. DDL focuses on defining and changing the database structure, while DML deals with the data stored within that structure. Understanding the difference between them makes it easier to manage databases and write SQL queries effectively. Data Definition Language, commonly known as DDL, is a group of SQL commands used to create, modify, and remove database objects. These objects include tables, schemas, and other structu…

entry.title: Top 20 Wapiti Commands Every Security Professional Should Know
entry.summary:
Wapiti is a powerful open-source web application vulnerability scanner written in Python. Unlike many commercial alternatives, Wapiti performs black-box scanning, meaning it analyzes the deployed web application without access to source code. It detects vulnerabilities such as SQL injection, cross-site scripting, file inclusion, command execution, and more. This second entry in our series covers the twenty most practical Wapiti commands, complete with explanations of when and why to use each one.
wapiti -u https://example.com/

entry.title: AWS ANS-C01 Retirement: Last Exam Day Is December 31, 2026
entry.summary:
AWS will retire the Advanced Networking – Specialty (ANS-C01) exam. The last day to take it is December 31, 2026. After that, AWS will not issue new ANS certifications.
Last exam day December 31, 2026
Successor exam None announced
AWS recommendation Digital networking training on AWS Skill Builder
Existing certifications Stay active for the standard three years
Recertification Not possible once the exam is retired
If you pass before the deadline, your certification stays active for three years. For example, a pass on December 30, 2026 keeps you certified until late 2029. Normally, AWS lets you recertify by passing the latest version of the exam. Once ANS-C01 is retired, there is no version left to pass. So your ANS certification will simply expire at the end of its three-year term. 65 multiple choice or multiple response questions 170 minutes Delivered at Pearson VUE test centers or online Available in English, Japanese, Korean and Simplified Chinese If you already hold an active AWS certification, you get 50% off your next exam Decide whether you want the credential. It still proves deep AWS networking skills for three years. If yes, book your exam well before December 31, 2026. Start practising with realistic questions now, because time is short. Source: the official AWS certification page for Advanced Networking – Specialty. 💡 Want to check if you're ready for ANS-C01? Try the sample exam quiz on testimea. Originally published on testimea.
